uncertainReason: Infobox attack speed is 'Variable' (per-attack cadence from the strategies guide is used instead); the wiki gives NO frequency for the Triple Attack or the Grapple, so the special-attack shares below are estimates, not wiki numbers.

attacks.name: spear stab aoe (Spear 1 / Spear 2 patterns)
attacks.note: Infobox: 'Max hit 44 (Typeless AOE)'. Main page: 'Sol primarily uses AoE attacks that are unaffected by prayer, forcing the player to dodge his attacks to avoid taking up to 44 typeless melee damage.' Strategies guide says 'They deal up to 45 Typeless Melee damage which can be completely avoided if dodged correctly' (44 vs 45 not reconciled by the wiki; 44 = infobox). Cadence: 'with the spear stabs being a 7-tick attack and the shield slam a 6-tick attack' and 'These attacks speed up by 1 tick each after he goes below 75% health' -> 7 ticks above 75% HP, 6 below. Dodge: Spear 1 'Avoided by stepping back 1 tile from his centre tile, or his corner tiles'; Spear 2 'Avoided by stepping back 1 tile diagonally on either side of his centre tile'; 'Sol will always begin the fight with this attack' (Spear 1). Standard play dodges every spear, so this row is listed and never counted. Share 0.4 is an estimate: spear and shield are the primary rotation ('if two of the same style, Spear attack or Shield attack, are used in a row, the second one will use a different pattern'); the wiki gives no spear:shield ratio, so 0.4/0.4 with 0.2 left for the two specials.

attacks.name: shield slam aoe (Shield 1 / Shield 2 patterns)
attacks.note: Same damage class as the spear: infobox '44 (Typeless AOE)', 'unaffected by prayer'. Strategies: 'the shield slam a 6-tick attack', 1 tick faster below 75% HP (6 -> 5). Dodge: Shield 1 (7x7 hazard, 1-tile safe gap) 'Dodged by moving 1 tile back'; Shield 2 ('increasing the middle hazard's area to 9x9') 'dodged by moving 2 tiles back'. Strategies: 'Keeping your Protect from Melee prayer on should be avoided, as it does not reduce his AOE damage.' Both spear and shield leave a 6x6 dust hazard under him ('making the attacks avoidable only by stepping out'). Avoidable under standard play; share 0.4 is an estimate (see spear row).

attacks.name: triple attack / triple parry, phases 1-3 (above 50% HP)
attacks.note: Main page: Triple Parry 'can be performed under 90% HP'; infobox '15-25-35 (Triple Parry 1)'. 'The damage from these hits are 15, 25 and 35 respectively' -> the three hits are NOT equal: 15 + 25 + 35 = 75 total per triple; maxHit here is the biggest single hit (35), so maxHit x hits (105) OVERSTATES the true 75 - use the sequence if you can. Timing: '1st attack is 3 ticks after the start of his animation; 2nd is 3 ticks after the first; 3rd is 3 ticks after the second' -> the whole special spans ~9 ticks (speedTicks 9). Prayer: 'requires the player to precisely activate Protect from Melee on the tick before he lands his spear'; strategies: 'Activating any protection prayer too early will disable it and force you to take the damage' and 'Sol will forcibly disable the prayer'. Style: the wiki never names stab/slash/crush, only 'Protect from Melee' and 'Spear attack' -> 'melee'. Flicked: each hit is telegraphed and blocked fully when timed; leak 0.1 = one mistimed flick in ten (estimate, wiki is silent). Share 0.05 = half of an estimated 0.1 overall special share, assigned to the top half of his HP (1500 -> 750 = phases 1-3); the wiki gives no frequency ('The text gives no statement about how often or when either special attack is used').

attacks.name: triple attack / triple parry, phase 4 onward (50% HP and below)
attacks.note: Infobox '15-30-45 (Triple Parry 2)'. Main page: 'from phase 4 onwards the second and third hits in sequence are increased to 30 and 45 respectively' -> 15 + 30 + 45 = 90 per triple (maxHit x hits = 135 overstates). Phase 4 = 50% HP (strategies headings: 'Phase 4 (50% HP, 750 HP)'). Timing: third hit '3 ticks after the second, or 4 if he is under 50%' -> ~10 ticks for the sequence. Same Protect-from-Melee tick-perfect block as above. Share 0.05 = the other half of the estimated 0.1 special share (bottom half of HP). Leak 0.1 is an estimate.

attacks.name: grapple / grab (below 75% HP)
attacks.note: Infobox '44 (Grapple)'; main page prose: equipment torn off for '~45 damage'; strategies: 'heavy damage (up to 45)' - 44 (infobox) kept, 45 noted. 'can only be performed below 75% HP'. Mechanic: he drops his shield and calls a body part; 'Once Sol calls out a body part, you have 4 ticks to defend the slot' (click the matching equipment slot); 'Defending on the last tick will give a perfect parry' (next attack within 5 ticks is a max hit). Style is not stated by the wiki -> typeless assumed (uncertain). Prayer interaction not stated. Standard play clicks the slot, so avoidable: listed, never counted. Change 24 April 2024: 'Sol Heredit will no longer damage players with his grab attack after he runs out of hitpoints.' Share 0.1 is an estimate (no wiki frequency); it only exists for the lower 75% of his HP.

attacks.name: light beam / laser sphere (phase transitions and enrage)
attacks.note: Main page: at each phase transition 'six beams of light spawn in a 9x9 area around the player and create molten sand after 2 ticks' and a crystal rotates the arena edges: 'after 4 ticks a sphere of light will be launched, dealing up to 75 damage'. Strategies: Light Beam 'can damage the player for 70+ damage'; 'If your position is targeted, you have 3 ticks to react and move out of the way'; enrage: beams fire about every 7 seconds and 'You have only 2 ticks to react'. Main page enrage: lasers aim 'every 4.2 ticks (7 seconds)' (the wiki's own tick/second pair is inconsistent; 7 s = ~12 ticks, used here). 'These lasers must be avoided at all costs, as they are by far the most dangerous hazard during the fight.' Frailty modifier note: 'the lasers being a guaranteed death if caught in them'. Style and prayer interaction are not stated -> typeless assumed. A parallel hazard, not an attack cycle (share 0); avoidable, never counted. Beams: 1 added at 75%, 50%, 25% ('No more beams are added after this, for a total of four').

attacks.name: molten sand (standing on a hazard tile)
attacks.note: Strategies, Molten Sand: 'Stepping on them will damage the player for ~6-8 damage (and increment Doom, if applicable) per tick.' Phase 2 (90%) adds the first 6 ('6 random tiles will be marked with a pillar of light'), phases 3-5 add 6 more each; enrage: 'Starts with 5 Molten Sands, adds more over time' at '1 extra Molten Sand every 1.8 seconds (3 game ticks)'; main page: molten sand targets one tile 'every 3 ticks (1.8 seconds)' in a 9x9 AoE around the player. Ground hazard, avoidable by positioning; share 0, never counted.

phases: Transitions at 90%, 75%, 50%, 25% and 10% HP ('Sol Heredit transitions phases at 90%, 75%, 50%, 25% and 10% HP respectively'). Phase 1 (100%, 1500 HP): spear (7t) and shield (6t) AoEs only. Phase 2 (90%, 1350 HP): 'continue to use his primary AOE attacks like in Phase 1', adds Molten Sand (6 tiles) and the Triple Attack. Phase 3 (75%, 1125 HP): 'addition of another new Light Beam, 6 more Molten Sands, and the grapple special attack. Additionally, Sol Heredit's primary AOE attacks will have their attack speed increased by 1 tick' (spear 6t, shield 5t). Phase 4 (50%, 750 HP): another beam + 6 sands; Triple Attack hits 2-3 become 30/45 and the final hit is delayed one tick. Phase 5 (25%, 375 HP): another beam + 6 sands (four beams total). Enrage (10%, 150 HP): 'Sol will become enraged, summoning a final batch of molten sands into the arena' - 1 extra sand every 3 ticks in a 9x9 around the player, lasers 'much more often' (~every 7 s, 2 ticks to react). Each transition spawns 6 beams (molten sand after 2 ticks) and a crystal sphere ('up to 75 damage'). After a transition he 'always opens with Spear 1'.
sanityOrOther: A clean kill takes no damage: every AoE is dodged by stepping (hover method / L method), the grapple is parried by clicking the called slot within 4 ticks, the Triple Attack is blocked by a tick-perfect Protect from Melee, beams/sand are positional. Prayer is otherwise useless ('Protect from Melee ... does not reduce his AOE damage') and praying too early is punished ('Sol will forcibly disable the prayer'). Blasphemy modifier can smite the prayer needed for the Triple Attack. Pattern memory: two same-style attacks in a row force the second pattern; a style switch resets it; 'will reset if a special attack (grapple or combo) was used'. Sol 'will be unable to move for 4 ticks starting on the tick he uses an AOE attack'. Perfect parry on the last tick empowers the next attack within 5 ticks to a max hit. Dumping dragon/burning claws below 10% is the recommended finisher.
